visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable views, including the curated 1024×640 preview. Individual mosque has a cream diamond lattice over a warm hemispherical dome, pale coursed prayer-hall ranges, two open mapped roof courtyards, one tall northern minaret/four corner minarets, six open pointed perimeter colonnades, three taller gates and four thin western auxiliary controls. Lattice grid now follows each shell facet, keeping its straight ribbons above the inner dome. Replaced oversized inner wooden fields with upper glazing and sparse smaller timber entries; the courtyard detail camera now looks upward to inspect the open roof and inward wall faces. Fine calligraphy, carving, exact geometric artwork, crescent, furnished interiors, visitors, landscape and elaborate paving are omitted. Dome/shaft faceting and simple pyramid-like merlon tips are intentional coarse reconstruction.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared-material/geographic-flat views and the placement overlay. Six existing 256² coursed limestone, raw limestone, membrane, marble, cast bronze and plain wood graphs serve seven merged roles with local opaque blue-grey panes. Metric UVs and linear colors; zero embedded images. Every graph is read once; unloading disposes model geometry and restores host ground. Retained anchor is fixed, and the first main edge supplies the axis. Map controls preserve actual tower centers, main outline/two holes, range outlines and thin western auxiliary geometry. The ground cutout/paved forecourt is an approximate rectangle derived from corner-tower bounds. Flat ground proves transforms, material reuse and footprint replacement, not surveyed paving/grade. This does not upgrade the previously documented terrain,architecture or physical-device scope.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final medium-fi frames: Economy/High, noon/late light, three distances, untextured silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions; also inspected the matched skyline at full size. Skyline 972 triangles retains main plan/two courts, five distinct tower silhouettes, warm faceted dome, gate arches and coarse open post-and-roof colonnades; lattice, fields and merlons drop out. District 2322 restores coarse cream lattice, sparse window rhythm and a few pointed colonnade bays. Street 10308 restores denser pointed arcades, recessed exterior panes, tower tier fields and sparse merlons. Closeup 23518 refines lattice/curves, facade rhythm, tier fields, columns and merlons. Initial skyline plus district is 333928 bytes plus shared textures, one/seven draws. Static shots show deliberate changes in lattice, bay and parapet density. Synthetic neighbors and coarse normal DEM are fixtures; full-city and physical phone/tablet/laptop timing remain pending.

Adaptive foundations support the approximate central court podium and separate western auxiliary controls. Preview terrain seats the podium and 1.5 m margin. Independently reproduced all 20 map controls/133 raw vertices, the current English-named mosque POI, original anchor and heading. Main has 18 raw outer vertices/two four-vertex roof courts; dome has 19 vertices; five tower centers and 20/91.5/45 m tags remain unchanged. The central podium rectangle is reproduced from actual corner-tower bounds and explicitly remains an approximate ground surface. All 132 renderer footprint checks pass across six GLBs: 20 selected controls covered and the two detached visitor/connector controls preserved. All 1056 FrontSide probes pass for court clearances and paving, five minaret tops/projecting tiers, colonnade/gate passages and intradoses, lattice ribbons in front of the inner shell, far canopy soffits and current recessed window fields. Reproduced 3375 raw central-podium DEM samples, 242 perimeter samples and 3124 seated preview points. Western thin controls have separate foundations outside the central cutout. Exact garden/paving divisions, thresholds, stairs, irrigation, drains and current grade joins remain unverified.

fidelityReview.notes: Individual medium-fi Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque: exact mapped main plan with two open courtyard holes, warm hemispherical dome and cream diamond lattice, one 91.5 m northern minaret and four 45 m corner minarets, six open pointed perimeter colonnades, three elevated gate ranges, pale pointed window/entry fields, stepped parapet and separate western auxiliary ranges. Main/corner tower positions and total tagged heights are controlled. Podium, dome top, low range heights, facade facing, internal levels and all fine architectural rhythm are explicit visualization estimates. Six existing shared 256² graphs serve seven merged material roles and four independent LODs. No generic stand-in, copied photographic textures, fine inscriptions/artwork or furnished interiors. Current main aggregate height is 20 m (layer 1); main minaret 91.5 m; four corner minarets 45 m. Dome has min_height 20 m and no top height; perimeter ranges/gates/western auxiliary controls have no heights. Main roof honors 20 m. Picture-led estimates: podium 0.7 m; low colonnade ranges 7.2 m; gateway arches to 13.5 m; west auxiliary ranges 6.5 m. Dome starts at 20 m, hemispherical warm inner shell rises about 14.2 m and cream lattice sits 0.18 m above it, with small finial to 37 m. Tower totals honor the current tags; shaft tiers, projecting balconies, slit fields and caps use estimated proportions. Lattice pattern, parapets, windows, entrance niches and all internal levels are coarse original reconstruction, not copied artwork or surveyed engineering. Two actually inspected 2023 Commons photographs by Francesco Bini guide the hall/dome, pointed portal, tower tiers and simplified lattice/merlons. No bespoke sources or redistributed pixels. Main aggregate 20 m, main tower 91.5 m, corner towers 45 m and dome min_height 20 m are mapped; dome top 37 m, low colonnades/gates, internal levels, profiles, windows, merlons and exact facade facing are estimates. Orientation uncertainty is 30 degrees; it is not a surveyed facing. Exact finishes, engineering, hidden rooms, furnished/collision-certified interiors, landscaping and physical-device timings remain unverified.
